stories.title: Irradiance: Implement GHI calculation helper
stories.description: Function to calculate Global Horizontal Irradiance from sunlight hours using Iceland atmospheric factors
stories.acceptance: Helper function returns reasonable GHI values (700-1000 kWh/m²/year for Iceland)

stories.title: Irradiance: Implement POA calculation
stories.description: Calculate Plane of Array irradiance for tilted panels using simplified formula: POA ≈ GHI × (1 + 0.15 × sin(tilt - lat + 15°))
stories.acceptance: POA calculation returns higher values than GHI for optimal tilt

stories.title: Irradiance: Calculate optimal tilt angle
stories.description: Determine optimal panel tilt for year-round production (latitude ± 5°)
stories.acceptance: Returns optimal tilt ~60-65° for Iceland locations

stories.title: Irradiance: Implement monthly irradiance breakdown
stories.description: Calculate monthly GHI and POA values, accounting for seasonal variation
stories.acceptance: Returns 12 months of irradiance data, summer > winter

stories.acceptance: Returns complete IrradianceResult with all fields populated

stories.title: Solar ROI: Calculate panel area and production
stories.description: Helper to calculate panelAreaM2 from systemSizeKW and annual production from POA irradiance
stories.acceptance: Formulas: panelArea = systemSizeKW / efficiency, production = POA × area × efficiency × (1-losses)

stories.title: Solar ROI: Calculate financial metrics
stories.description: Compute annualSavingsEUR, paybackYears, 25-year return with degradation
stories.acceptance: Realistic payback 8-15 years for Iceland, proper degradation calculation

stories.title: Solar ROI: Monthly production breakdown

stories.title: Solar ROI: Viability assessment
stories.description: Determine isViable flag and viabilityRating (excellent/good/marginal/poor) based on payback years
stories.acceptance: Rating logic: excellent <10y, good 10-15y, marginal 15-20y, poor >20y
